id: # Curated high-frequency Maltese. Tier 1 = learn first. Verbs are given in the 1sg
# present ("I ..."), which is what you actually say; `note` holds the 3ms perfect
# (the dictionary/root form) so you can look them up.

ex_en: He is a friend of mine.
I want to come, but I can't.
I didn't come because I was tired.
If you want, I can help you.
I came in order to learn.

note: verb is wrapped: ma + verb + x
becomes f' before a vowel: f'Malta

ex_en: The cat is under the chair.

note: b' before a vowel; bil- + article

ex_en: The shop next to the church.
I'll wait for you in front of the house.

note: għandi, għandek, għandu, għandha, għandna, għandkom, għandhom
3ms perfect: kien. Often dropped in the present.
root: ried. irrid, trid, irid, trid, irridu...

ex_en: How do you say this in Maltese?
The book is on the table.
The church is in the square.
I get up early in the morning.
On Sunday we go to the sea.
I need to see a doctor.

note: also a toast and a farewell

ex_en: The building is on the left.
Excuse me, where is the market?
